name: Citizenship by Naturalisation

requirements.blocker_text: No fewer than 5 years of legal residence in Latvia (Citizenship Law, Article 12, Section 1), with at most one break not exceeding one year and none in the final year before applying.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 5 years of legal residence in Latvia.

requirements.blocker_text: Demonstrated Latvian language proficiency per Article 20 of the Citizenship Law.
Knowledge of the basic provisions of the Satversme (Constitution), the state anthem, and the basics of Latvian history and culture.
A legal source of income (legāls iztikas avots).

sources.title: likumi.lv (Latvia's official legal database, published by Latvijas Vestnesis, the state gazette) -- Citizenship Law (Pilsonibas likums), Article 12 Section 1: 5-year residence, Latvian language proficiency (Article 20), Constitution/anthem/history knowledge, legal income source; Article 9 Section 1: dual citizenship permitted only for citizens acquiring EU/EEA, NATO, Australian, Brazilian, or New Zealand citizenship, or citizenship of a state with a bilateral dual-citizenship treaty

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Latvia). dual_citizenship_allowed is set FALSE here as the general default for naturalised citizens under Article 12, since Article 9's exceptions are narrow and country-specific (EU/EEA, NATO, Australia, Brazil, New Zealand, or bilateral-treaty states only) rather than a blanket allowance -- an applicant from one of those specific countries or groupings WOULD retain dual citizenship, but this is not modeled as a universal true/false flag without conflating 'sometimes, for specific nationalities' with 'generally allowed.' Latvia does NOT grant citizenship automatically through marriage: Article 5 explicitly states marriage 'neither grants nor removes' Latvian citizenship for either party -- a genuine structural absence, disclosed here rather than a fabricated marriage-based route, consistent with this dataset's convention (see Azerbaijan and Vietnam). Latvia also has a unique, closed historical category of 'non-citizens' (nepilsoni) -- mostly Soviet-era settlers and their descendants who hold neither Latvian citizenship nor foreign citizenship -- but this status has not been open to new registrants for decades and is not a route a current migrant can access, so it is not modeled as a file here.
